subject: Invoice delivery preference and billing contact confirmation
messages:
From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@nubislabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@nubislabs.com
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Setting up invoice delivery for Nubi Labs (PO attached)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking a look. We're ready to start moving forward on Redwood for the Nubi Labs pilot. AP had a quick question about how invoices will be delivered monthly: they prefer getting a PDF copy to accounts-payable@nubislabs.com (email-only), and they will not be using a vendor portal.

A few specifics from AP:
- Delivery: email copy to accounts-payable@nubislabs.com (single recipient).
- PO: PO-7894 (attached) should be referenced on invoices.
- Tax: Nubi Labs is US-based; AP will need the W-9 on file.

Can you confirm Redwood can support email-only delivery and whether you need any additional fields on the invoice (PO on header, remit address, tax id)?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Neil
Finance Operations
Nubi Labs

Attachments: PO-7894.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@nubislabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Setting up invoice delivery for Nubi Labs (PO attached)

Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Yes, we can do email-only delivery to accounts-payable@nubislabs.com. A few operational notes and options so expectations are clear: 

1) Email-only (recommended for small pilots)
   - We will send a PDF invoice to the AP mailbox for each billing cycle.
   - Invoice filename will follow: RED-<invoice-number>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (sample attached).
   - We can include the PO on the invoice header and the remit address.

2) Portal / API option (not required)
   - Offers an archived copy and webhook/push if you later want programmatic retrieval.
   - Adds a simple onboarding step for your AP team.

For tax: we do require W-9 for US customers; attach the completed W-9 and I'll upload to our vendor records.

Next steps for us to complete setup:
- Confirm the single AP email to receive PDFs (you listed accounts-payable@nubislabs.com)
- Confirm invoice signer name (person who will be the invoice issuer on file)
- Send completed W-9 (if not already attached)

I attached a sample invoice (RED-1001) and a one-page invoice-setup checklist for AP. If email-only is agreed, I'll mark the account as "email-only: true" in our billing system and skip portal invites.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: sample-invoice-RED-1001.pdf, invoice-setup-checklist.csv

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@nubislabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Setting up invoice delivery for Nubi Labs (PO attached)

Kim / Liam — 

Quick operational note from the billing side: if Nubi Labs confirms email-only, billing will:
- Create the billing contact as accounts-payable@nubislabs.com (no portal invite).
- Tag the account with PO required and include PO-7894 in the invoice metadata.
- Record the W-9 in vendor files and set tax profile to US domestic.

Kim, can you also add a HubSpot note (Company 67890) with the AP contact and attach the PO/W-9? Marissa, looping you for collections cadence — if payment terms are Net30, we'll enable the standard reminder flow; change if AP requests otherwise.

Connor
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Thanks — we agree to email-only delivery.

AP contact for records: accounts-payable@nubislabs.com (this goes to a shared mailbox monitored by AP team).
Invoice signer on our side should read: "Nimbus Labs, Attn: Accounts Payable" — please do NOT list a specific individual.

I've attached our completed W-9 for your vendor file. Payment terms are Net30. If you could confirm after upload that the W-9 is received and the billing contact has been created, that's perfect.

—Liam

Attachments: completed-w9.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Setting up invoice delivery for Nubi Labs (PO attached)

Hi Liam — all set.

What I did:
- Uploaded completed-w9.pdf to vendor file.
- Created billing contact: accounts-payable@nubislabs.com (email-only delivery).
- Added PO-7894 to the billing metadata and ensured it prints on the invoice header.
- Set payment terms to Net30 and enabled standard Net30 reminders.

Attached is the sample invoice you can expect (RED-1001) and a short checklist of the fields we included. We'll send the first invoice after the usage billing run on 2028-08-01; it will reference PO-7894 and be emailed to accounts-payable@nubislabs.com.

Related: I added a HubSpot note and linked the DocuSign packet (for paperwork we sometimes use for large contracts) to the company record. If anything changes on your side (change of AP email or signature requirements), reply here and we'll update the config.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
